chunks.arabic_text: وَسَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, peace be upon them:

chunks.arabic_text: عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ زَنَتْ هَلْ تَصْلُحُ أَنْ تُسْتَرْضَعَ

translations.en: About a woman who committed adultery: is she suitable to be taken as a wet nurse?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ "لَا تَصْلُحُ وَلَا لَبَنُ ابْنَتِهَا الَّتِي وُلِدَتْ مِنَ الزِّنَا".

translations.en: He said: "She is not suitable, nor the milk of her daughter who was born from adultery."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning wet nursing. It states that a woman who committed adultery is not suitable to be employed as a wet nurse, and likewise the milk of her daughter born from adultery is not considered suitable.
en.seo_question: Is a woman who committed adultery allowed to serve as a wet nurse in Shia hadith?

key_terms.تُسْتَرْضَعَ: to be taken as a wet nurse
